meta.query: Compare phases for trials involving semaglutide vs tirzepatide.

plan.rationale: Compare the phase distributions of trials involving semaglutide versus tirzepatide.

counting_rules: Drug filter: ClinicalTrials.gov search results were kept only if an intervention name, a registered synonym of it, or the brief title names the drug (placebo arms don't count). The matching field is included in each citation; dropped trials are listed in meta.cohorts[].excluded_nct_ids.
Trials registered under two phases (e.g. Phase 1 and Phase 2) are counted once, in a combined 'Phase 1/2' bucket, so bars sum to the number of trials.
share_of_cohort = trial_count / trials analyzed in that cohort.
